solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Churchmen smell a piece of chicken?

parts.note: parsons are parish clergymen
to nose is to smell or sniff out

explanation.surface: Clergymen catching the scent of roast chicken at Sunday lunch.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags that the definition is a jokey name for a cut of poultry.
explanation.definitionFit: The fatty rump at the tail end of a cooked fowl is jocularly named after clergy, so it is one piece of the bird.

clue.text: Perform the role of accountant, lifted by words of gratitude

indicators.note: in a down entry, raising a word up means reading it from bottom to top

parts.note: CA is a chartered accountant
ta is British informal thanks, made plural here

explanation.surface: A bookkeeper, cheered by thanks, takes on a part in a play.
explanation.definitionFit: To act as someone is to serve in their capacity or play their part.

clue.text: Comic-book star rose up magically, holding that lady

indicators.note: the rearranged letters wrap around another piece
letters transformed as if by magic are rearranged

parts.note: her refers to a woman already mentioned

explanation.surface: A cartoon heroine levitates by magic, carrying a woman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'magically' turns ROSE UP into SUPERO, and 'holding' puts HER inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: A caped crusader with special powers is the typical lead of a comic book.

clue.text: Smart current newspaper in US city

indicators.note: the other pieces go inside the abbreviation for the US city

parts.note: NY is New York
I is the physics symbol for electric current
FT is the Financial Times

explanation.surface: A stylish, up-to-date paper sold in New York.
explanation.definitionFit: Nifty means clever, neat or stylish, all senses of smart.

clue.text: Sister omitting nothing in part of speech

indicators.note: a letter is left out of the word for a part of speech

parts.note: a noun is a grammatical part of speech
O looks like zero, nothing

explanation.surface: A sibling leaves nothing out of her speech.
explanation.definitionFit: A member of a religious order of women is addressed as Sister.

clue.text: Belt up one so nervous

parts.note: British slang for be quiet, which is also expressed as sh
I is the Roman numeral one
so and very both intensify, as in so tired

explanation.surface: A passenger told to fasten their seatbelt because they look anxious.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Belt up' looks like buckling a seatbelt, but in British slang it means shut up.
explanation.definitionFit: Trembling or quivering with fear or cold, so jittery and nervous.

clue.text: Badly done now? Oops! Here's booby prize

indicators.note: things done badly are messed up, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A clumsy performer is handed the consolation award for last place.
explanation.definitionFit: A mock award for the competitor who comes last, traditionally a carved kitchen utensil.

clue.text: Depression in young man broadcast where personal problems are published

indicators.note: the dip goes inside the rearranged letters
scattered like seed, so the letters are mixed up

parts.note: a col is a dip or pass between mountain peaks

explanation.surface: A young man's depression is aired where readers' troubles appear.
explanation.walkthrough: 'broadcast' turns YOUNG MAN into AGONYUMN, and 'in' places COL inside.
explanation.definitionFit: The newspaper feature where an advice writer answers readers' letters about their troubles.

clue.text: In station, tape's readily available

indicators.note: the letters sit inside the words station and tape's, running across the gap between them

explanation.surface: A recording kept at a broadcasting station that can be played at any moment.
explanation.definitionFit: Beer drawn from a barrel is on draught, hence idiomatically anything ready for immediate use.

clue.text: Combat sport which often divides neighbours

definitions.meaning: the Olympic sport of swordplay with foils, épées and sabres
the fences or railings standing along a boundary between two gardens

explanation.surface: A contact sport that, wryly, is also what keeps neighbours apart.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names both the sport of duelling with swords and the boundary barriers put up between properties.

clue.text: See dry rot, unfortunately in naval vessel

indicators.note: something gone wrong suggests these letters have been jumbled into a fresh order

explanation.surface: A surveyor warns of decaying timber discovered aboard a warship.
explanation.definitionFit: A fast, heavily armed warship of a navy, used to escort fleets and hunt submarines.

clue.text: Unexpectedly encounter a mongrel under ladder

indicators.note: in a down entry the following pieces sit beneath the first

parts.note: in British usage a ladder is a run in tights or stockings
a cross is a crossbred animal, a mongrel

explanation.surface: Bumping into a stray dog sitting under a ladder, a double dose of bad luck.
explanation.definitionFit: To meet or find by chance is to happen upon someone without planning it.

clue.text: Heroin regularly taken for a very long time

indicators.note: taking every other letter of the word Heroin, starting from its second

explanation.surface: Someone has been using a hard drug habitually for ages.
explanation.definitionFit: An aeon is an immeasurably long period, a geological age.

clue.text: Steal the Spanish coin

parts.note: to nick is British slang for to steal
el is the Spanish word for the

explanation.surface: Pocket the old Spanish coin.
explanation.definitionFit: In North America the five-cent piece is called by the metal it was made from.

clue.text: Crater roughly enclosing tree

indicators.note: the two letters for roughly are split around the tree

parts.note: ca is short for circa, about
the alder is a tree of the birch family

explanation.surface: A volcanic hollow approximately surrounding a single tree.
explanation.definitionFit: A large basin formed when a volcano collapses after eruption, a kind of crater.

clue.text: Fashionable basin reportedly matching

parts.note: something in fashion is in

indicators.note: says that the word for a basin is heard rather than spelt

parts.note: a sink is a kitchen or bathroom basin

explanation.surface: A trendy washbasin that matches the rest of the bathroom.
explanation.definitionFit: Things in synchronisation move together in step, so they are aligned or in agreement.

clue.text: Father left friend

parts.note: pa is an informal word for father

explanation.surface: Dad walked out on a friend.
explanation.definitionFit: A pal is a mate or chum, an informal synonym.

clue.text: Conservative sold headless pack of fish

indicators.note: the word sold loses its head, its first letter

parts.note: a school is a large group of fish swimming together

explanation.surface: A traditionalist fishmonger sold a whole shoal minus the heads.
explanation.definitionFit: Being of the traditional kind, holding to old-fashioned ways, is a fair sense of conservative.

clue.text: Doctor in private room, a person of great energy

indicators.note: the doctor goes inside the word for a private room

parts.note: a den is a private study or retreat
MO is a medical officer

explanation.surface: A tireless physician working in a secluded study.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone tackling a task with fierce energy is called a demon for work.

clue.text: Fruit old and bad rejected

indicators.note: turned back, so in this down entry the word for bad reads upwards

parts.note: evil means wicked or bad

explanation.surface: Stale fruit gone off is thrown out.
explanation.definitionFit: The small oily stone fruit of a Mediterranean tree.

clue.text: Type of delivery completed by member

parts.note: something finished is over
a limb such as an arm is a member of the body

explanation.surface: A delivery service handled by one staff member.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket, a delivery is a ball bowled; bowling must be done with the arm swung above the shoulder.
explanation.definitionFit: Bowling with the arm brought over the shoulder describes a style of cricket ball delivery.

clue.text: A sort of church expert

parts.note: CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: Someone who is a specialist in one kind of church.
explanation.definitionFit: An ace is a highly skilled person, a virtuoso.

clue.text: Narcotic I dump at the centre, after work

indicators.note: the other pieces come after the word for work

parts.note: op is short for opus, a musical work

indicators.note: only the middle letters of the word dump are wanted

explanation.surface: Someone discards a drug at the heart of their workplace.
explanation.definitionFit: A drug extracted from poppies, a classic sleep-inducing narcotic.

clue.text: Prayer that gives one a lift

definitions.meaning: the Lord's Prayer, named from its Latin opening words Our Father
a lift of open cars moving continuously on a loop, which passengers step on and off

explanation.definitionFit: The Latin name of the Lord's Prayer is also given to a continuous chain-of-cabins elevator, likened to rosary beads.
